description: Intrekgebieden waterwinning is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Een waterwinning trekt grondwater aan uit een gebied dat groter is dan het grondwaterbeschermingsgebied. De intrekgebieden “leveren” feitelijk het grondwater voor de drinkwatervoorziening. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are drinkwater, drinkwateronttrekkingen, grondwaterwinning, provinciale-milieuverordening, provinciale-verordeningen. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTML, JPEG, WFS_SRVC, WMS_SRVC, HTTPS://DATA.OVERHEID.NL/FORMAT/UNKNOWN. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
